limits: The four records have valid world-room indexes, screen coordinates and validated sprite masks, but their quest identity, collection behavior and placement algorithm are not yet proved. Each output room matches a source-read world-layout index; this does not explain how the lookup index is chosen. Equal entry RNG paired with equal output and unequal RNG paired with differing rooms are insufficient for a causal RNG formula because registers and phase also differ. The two paths do not support fixed four-room placement. A pickup test needs a naturally reached active same-room record or complete validated cross-room state; actor-room teleport alone was not attempted. No record values, instruction bytes, images or disassembly are published.
